meta.landingTitle: From a research question to a reviewed paper
meta.landingDescription: A research pipeline of AI agents where a person approves every stage: literature, method, coding, experiment and writing.

hero.subtitle: Agents search the literature, propose a method, write the code, run the experiment and draft the paper. You approve each stage before the next one starts.
hero.inviteOnly: Accounts are created by invitation from a lab admin.

demo.label: Example run
demo.topic: Monocular depth estimation on NYU Depth V2
demo.caption: An illustration of how a run moves through the pipeline, not live data.

steps.done: Every stage approved: the paper draft is ready

capabilities.title: Built for careful research
capabilities.subtitle: Agents do the groundwork; people make the decisions.

stages.title: Five stages, one pipeline
stages.body: Literature, method, coding, experiment and writing run in order, and each stage builds on the approved output of the one before.

approval.title: A person approves every step
approval.body: Approve, request changes with a comment, or reject. A decision applies to the exact version you reviewed; if the output changes, you see the new version first.

budget.title: Paid models within budget, free models otherwise
budget.body: Runs use paid models while your monthly budget allows, then continue on free models. Set a cost cap per run, or use free models only.

sandbox.title: GPU sandbox with provenance
sandbox.body: Experiments run in a locked-down GPU container with no network access. Results keep their provenance: image, code, configuration, dataset version and seed.

languages.title: English and Korean
languages.body: Every screen, message and error is available in both languages. Switch at any time.

how.title: Four steps, with you in the loop

ask.title: Start a run
ask.body: Create a project, add your lab and describe the research question. Choose paid or free models and an optional cost cap.

agents.title: Agents do the groundwork
agents.body: From the literature to the draft, each stage works from the approved result of the stage before it.

review.title: Review every stage
review.body: Read the output, then approve it, ask for changes with a comment, or reject it. Nothing moves on without your decision.

paper.title: Finish with a reviewed draft
paper.body: The writing stage drafts the paper from approved work, with citations linked to the papers that were found.

sources.title: Grounded in open scholarship
sources.subtitle: The literature stage is built around open metadata and open-access full text from these sources.
sources.label: Data sources

closing.title: Ready when your lab is
closing.body: Use the account from your lab invitation. Every run waits for your approval at each stage.

footer.note: Studio and Classic show the same projects, runs and data.

auth.panelBody: Agents do the groundwork. You decide what moves forward.

points.approve: Approve, revise or reject each stage
points.budget: Paid models within your budget, free models after

palette.description: Jump to a page or a project, or change the interface, language or theme.

dashboard.subtitle: Here is where your research stands.
